account_files_dimensions.name: account_files_dimensions
account_files_dimensions.value: ("account_files"."width" is null and "account_files"."height" is null) or ("account_files"."width" is not null and "account_files"."height" is not null and "account_files"."width" > 0 and "account_files"."height" > 0)

admin_actions_subject_matches_action.name: admin_actions_subject_matches_action
admin_actions_subject_matches_action.value:
case
        when "admin_actions"."action" in ('tenant.create', 'tenant.rename', 'tenant.suspend', 'tenant.restore', 'tenant.delete')
          then "admin_actions"."subject_tenant_id" is not null and "admin_actions"."tenant_slug" is not null
            and ("admin_actions"."subject_account_id" is not null) = ("admin_actions"."action" = 'tenant.create')
        else "admin_actions"."subject_account_id" is not null and "admin_actions"."subject_tenant_id" is null and "admin_actions"."tenant_slug" is null
      end

shop_sellers_not_blank.name: shop_sellers_not_blank
shop_sellers_not_blank.value: btrim("shop_sellers"."seller_name") <> '' and btrim("shop_sellers"."seller_address") <> '' and btrim("shop_sellers"."seller_registration_number") <> '' and btrim("shop_sellers"."contact_email") <> ''

uploaded_files_dimensions.name: uploaded_files_dimensions
uploaded_files_dimensions.value: ("uploaded_files"."width" is null and "uploaded_files"."height" is null) or ("uploaded_files"."width" is not null and "uploaded_files"."height" is not null and "uploaded_files"."width" > 0 and "uploaded_files"."height" > 0)
